summary:
丹納赫本季 EPS 超預期6.5%，營收年增3.7%，生命科學與診斷溫和復甦。
• EPS 2.06 美元，較預估1.94超出6.45%。
• 營收5.95億美元（B級），年增3.66%回到正成長。
• 獲利優於預期，反映成本控管與營運效率。
• 生命科學工具與診斷需求逐步回穩。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 超預期且營收重回正成長，顯示生命科學循環觸底回升的初步跡象。短期獲利韌性支撐股價，但3.66%營收成長仍偏低，市場給予35倍本益比已隱含復甦預期，容錯空間有限。中期看點在生物製藥資本支出回溫與中國需求回穩。追蹤指標：核心營收成長、生命科學分部訂單、毛利率與併購整合。

需留意：生物製藥客戶資本支出與庫存去化仍偏謹慎。；中國市場需求與政策不確定性。；本益比35偏高，對成長放緩較敏感。

summary_en:
Danaher beat EPS by 6.5% with 3.7% revenue growth as life sciences and diagnostics recover modestly.
• EPS of $2.06 beat the $1.94 estimate by 6.45%.
• Revenue of $5.95B returned to growth, up 3.66% year over year.
• Profit topped expectations on cost control and operating efficiency.
• Life-science tools and diagnostics demand is gradually stabilizing.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: an EPS beat alongside a return to revenue growth hints at an early bottoming of the life-science cycle. Near-term earnings resilience supports the stock, but 3.66% revenue growth is still soft and a 35x P/E already prices in recovery, leaving little margin for error. Mid-term watch a rebound in biopharma capex and China stabilization. Track core revenue growth, life-science orders, gross margin, and M&A integration.

Watch：Biopharma customers remain cautious on capex and inventory destocking.; China demand and policy uncertainty persist.; A P/E of 35 is elevated and sensitive to slowing growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出6.45%，但營收年增僅3.66%顯示復甦溫和。
